title: feat(spec,automation): FlowRuntimeState.unboundCause classifies an unbound flow row beside its reason
body:
Fixes #23842
Clause-②: yes

## What

`FlowRuntimeState` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts`) gains an optional, closed `unboundCause` beside `reason`. Its values are published as the tuple `FLOW_UNBOUND_CAUSES`, with the derived type `FlowUnboundCause`, so a consumer can enumerate them. This follows the `APPROVAL_STATUSES` / `ApprovalStatus` convention in the same contracts folder. `reason` stays the rendered sentence. Its docblock still says "do not parse it", and now points to `unboundCause` for anyone who needs to classify the row.

`AutomationEngine.describeUnboundReason` (`packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts`) is the single producer of `reason`. Both the status door and `getTriggerBindingAudit()` read it. Each of its branches now returns `{ reason, cause }`, and `getFlowRuntimeStates()` spreads the two together, so on every row they are either both present or both absent. Neither the sentences nor the audit's shape changed.

## The measured set of causes (4, not the card's example 2)

I read every branch of `describeUnboundReason` at `3fed1eb00`. It composes four distinct causes, each with its own owner and remedy:

| value | branch | owner / remedy |
|---|---|---|
| `deployment_policy` | `policyDisabledFlows` (the recorded `ScheduledWorkPolicy` refusal) | operator: the deployment switch or the host; not a defect |
| `disabled_subflow` | `subflowDeclinedFlows` (ADR-0126 §7.3 arming gate) | admin: enable the packaged subflow, and the caller arms |
| `missing_trigger` | no trigger of the declared type is registered | author: `requires: ['triggers']` / the trigger package |
| `binding_failure` | the trigger is registered, but binding threw | engineering: the earlier boot warnings |

None of them is merged with another, because no two share a remedy. `missing_trigger` and `binding_failure` both have an engineering owner, but one is fixed by adding a dependency and the other by reading a stack trace. There is no catch-all `other`: the branch set is closed.

## Wire mirrors

`GET /automation/_status` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts`) passes `getFlowRuntimeStates()` rows through verbatim and is typed against the contract, so it needs no change. No zod schema in `packages/spec/src/api` mirrors `FlowRuntimeState`: I searched for `triggerType` and `_status` and found only a docblock mention. I regenerated the `api-surface/contracts.json` and `export-origins/contracts.json` baselines with `gen:api-surface` and `gen:export-origins`. `check:generated` exit 0.

## Tests (head `7ba22e988d`)

- Pairing pins, one per cause:
  - `engine.test.ts`: the status row for `deployment_policy`, `binding_failure` for a bind that throws, and `missing_trigger` in the two-doors test.
  - `subflow-guard-every-door.test.ts`: `disabled_subflow`, and that the cause clears when the subflow is re-enabled and the caller arms.
- Control: the DARK test now covers a bound row, a disabled row and a manual (trigger-less) flow, and asserts that none of them carries `reason` or `unboundCause`.
- Spec: type identities pin `FlowRuntimeState['unboundCause']` to the tuple union. A runtime test checks that the values are unique and snake_case with no `other`, and that the docblock still forbids parsing `reason` and points at `unboundCause`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run`: 186 files / 2501 tests passed. Spec `automation-service.test.ts`: 18 passed. `typecheck` for both packages: exit 0.
- Ablation: I replaced `return { reason: policyReason, cause: 'deployment_policy' };` with `return { reason: policyReason } as any;` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor x1 → x0, blob changed). `engine.test.ts` went red on 2 pins: "OFF: the status row names the policy…" and "the two doors answer the SAME sentence…". After the restore, the blob equals HEAD (`4c735c08…`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty. No build was needed, because the suite imports `./engine.js` from source.

## Gates

`dispatch-gates --commands` on this diff gives 90 derived families. `--ran` reconciliation: 89 run, 1 NOT MEASURED. Every family I ran exited 0. `check:plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exited 3 at first on the shallow clone and exited 0 after `git fetch --unshallow`. NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, which exited 3 because it needs a full `pnpm build`. That is left to CI. `check:dev-prereqs`: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- `getTriggerBindingAudit()` entries still carry only `reason`. Adding `cause` there would widen a second surface the card does not name, so I did not.
- Downstream: the console chip and banner (objectstack-ai/objectui#12609) can read `unboundCause === 'deployment_policy'` once this ships in a published `@objectstack/spec`. The seat files that card. objectui is not touched here.
